instruction: A candid street photograph captures a full-length shot of two men walking on a city sidewalk under green trees during the day. On the left, the white man in the pink shirt (R2) walks forward, holding a clear plastic cup in his right hand while looking to his right. On the right, the Black man in the white shirt (R1) walks alongside him, looking back at his partner. The two men are holding hands as they stroll together. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight filtering through the leaves, creating gentle shadows on the pavement with a cool color palette.

R1 looks back at R2 while they stroll together
